name: Barmah Park Restaurant & Cellar Door
signature: A Moorooduc winery restaurant and cellar door for a meal alongside the estate wines.
editorNote: Barmah Park combines a restaurant and cellar door in Moorooduc. If you’re doing both, the cellar-door team recommends allowing 30 minutes for a tasting before lunch. The cellar door lists tastings from 11am to 5pm, Wednesday to Sunday; restaurant service and reservations are separate.
whyWeGo: A restaurant and cellar door make a convenient single stop for food and wine in Moorooduc.
ifOnlyOneThing: Check the current restaurant menu and reserve your preferred sitting directly with Barmah Park.
